subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below:

(Left) 448 455 275 563 215 (Right)

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the largest number is added to the second digit of the smallest number?
solution:
Given: (left) 448 455 275 563 215 (right)

The third digit of the largest number is: 3 (563)

And,

The second digit of the smallest number is: 1 (215)

So, the addition of the third digit of the largest number and the second digit of the smallest number is:

→ 3 + 1 = 4

The correct answer is "Option 2".
